title: PTC DFT Expert output contract
description: Mirrors the fields scripts/validate_dft_outputs.py enforces. Necessity follows User_input/DFT解析规则.txt: required = Item/Name/Trim/上电处理(vset|iset)/寄存器配置/结果测量; optional = level/Description/ExpectValue/Unit/Dynamic/Helper/de_test. Optional fields are recorded verbatim in rawIntent but do not fail validation.

rawIntent.description: field-for-field verbatim copy of the canonical OVERVIEW row, all columns including optional ones

identity.description: Name: parameter name; one Item may carry several

pin.description: single Pin (vs AGND) or PinA2PinB / PinA_PinB (relative)

value.description: vset: V; iset: A; sign per rules file

status.description: power-on stage; stage 0 completes before stage 1

rampFrom.description: set when pluseTime=100e-3 or same-Pin same-status run: start = previous stage same-Pin value

x-artifacts-note: <ROOT> is resolved from the task address book (training=Training_Materials, delivery=project/DALI); the guard enforces via the training bindings allowlist, not via this declaration.

x-semantic-review.reviewedArtifacts: 数组 [{path, sha256}] 或对象 {文件名: sha256}，sha256 按磁盘字节计算，必须与当前 dft-meta.json / dft-conditions.yaml 实际一致

x-gate-sync: 修改01: x-artifacts 改逻辑位 <ROOT>（原 project/DALI 写死路径废除）
修改02: 顶层 required 新增 sourceLocation（sheet+row）
修改03: 顶层 required 新增 parseStatus（ok|selfResolved|pendingUser）
修改04: 顶层 required 新增 openItems（结构化 conflict/missingField/unparsable/pinAlarm）
修改05: testCondition.required 精简为 6 项（identity/isTrim/powerSequence/registerFieldIntent/measurement/involvedPins）

修改06: 原 20 项 required 中其余 14 项全部降级 optional（remarks/expectedValue/hasRamp/ramps/helperIntent/scanIntent/dynamicPins/highCurrent/differentialVoltage/internalComparison/referenceValue/notes/powerSequence旧形态/measurement旧形态）
修改07: powerSequence 结构化为 vset/iset 四元组数组（cmd/pin/value/pluseTime/status + rampFrom）
修改08: registerFieldIntent 结构化为 field/en_tm 条目数组（按 Item 索引 reg_config）
修改09: measurement 增加规则文件语法约束
修改10: 新增 x-dft-parsing-rules 指向解析规则文件（必要/非必须的权威来源）

修改03: rawIntent 校验改为有值字段覆盖——workbook 空单元格不检查（记法自由），键与值比较前做换行归一化（CRLF 视同 LF），有值但 rawIntent 缺失或记空仍判败（防漏读）；dft-conditions.yaml 为语义级对齐——宽松解析 testCondition（单行 JSON、多行嵌套映射、裸标量均可），rawIntent 段仅为渲染不参与校验；dft-semantic-review 的 reviewedArtifacts 接受数组 [{path, sha256}] 或对象 {文件名: sha256} 两种形态，sha256 一律按磁盘字节计算
